column1: Hi, I'm interested in learning more about your strata management services. We're a new 50-unit residential development and don't have a manager yet. Can you send information about your packages and pricing?
Our residents are complaining about slow water pressure in building C. We've already replaced the main valve once. Can someone from your team come inspect the system?
I've been trying to reach someone about our November invoice for three weeks now. This is unacceptable service. Nobody answers the phone and emails are ignored.
What's the difference between a strata manager and a body corporate administrator?
We need help setting up a special levy for a new roof replacement. Can you walk us through the process and timeline?
This is the third time in two months your team has double-charged our unit owners. We need an immediate review of our billing and a full refund. Your service quality has been terrible.
Hi, we're from a small 12-unit building in Dumaguete and looking for someone to take over management. What does your onboarding process look like?
How do I access the online portal to pay my levy? I forgot my password and can't find the reset link.
I want to lodge a formal complaint about the building superintendent hired by your company. He's been rude to residents and has been spotted drinking during work hours.
Can you explain what's included in a standard body corporate audit?
Our developer just handed over the building to us and we're overwhelmed. We need someone experienced to handle everything from levy collection to vendor management. Are you taking new clients?
The common area lighting was supposed to be fixed last month. It's still broken and residents are tripping in the dark. Why hasn't this been done?
Do you handle body corporate insurance or can you recommend a provider?
Our last manager disappeared with six months of collected levies. We need an emergency manager and legal advice on how to recover the funds.
